answers.how: The man moves about 660 px in 3.292 s, giving a scale of 0.00844 m/px. His full standing height is about 218 px.
Using the elapsed time: 1.693 m/s × 3.292 s.
A horizontal tile edge near the man's walking line measures about 67 px. Multiplying by 0.00844 m/px gives the side length.
The back-wall span from the floor to the ceiling is about 222 px. Multiplying by 0.00844 m/px gives the height.
